## Background

The [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/) website has world data. It is nice that they have provided graphics and the data that they used to generate the graphics. We are going to recreate one of their visualizations.

## Task

1.  Review the [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/) webpage and find a graphic that interests you. Using the data from their website, spend a couple of hours recreating their graphic as closely as you can in an `.qmd` file . (Make sure you keep the link or can navigate back to the original chart on their website).
2.  Be sure to include a link to or a snapshop of the graphic you are trying to recreate in your `.qmd` file
3.  Render the `.qmd` file. Push all files created as part of the render to your GitHub repository.

### Submit

In I-learn submit the link to your `html` file hosted on your repo's GitHub pages.
:::
